scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start:all: echo Ejecute en 2 terminales: npm run dev:api y npm run dev:web
scripts.docker:up: npm run sync:env && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.docker:dev: npm run sync:env && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build --force-recreate web
scripts.docker:dev:all: npm run sync:env && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build
scripts.docker:web:restart: npm run sync:env && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml stop web && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml rm -f web && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build web
scripts.docker:api:restart: npm run sync:env && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build --force-recreate api
scripts.docker:logs:web: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml logs -f web
scripts.docker:intiva: docker compose --profile intiva --env-file .env.docker up -d --build intiva-tunnel api web
scripts.docker:intiva:logs: docker compose --profile intiva logs -f intiva-tunnel api
